kjv: in that day shall the decree be far removed
mine: In that day the boundary shall be far extended
note: hoq can be "decree" or "boundary"; in context of rebuilding walls and peoples streaming in, the frontier is extended, not a decree removed.

kjv: from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river
mine: from ... the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt to the River
note: matsor is a poetic name for Egypt (as in 2 Kgs 19:24, Isa 19:6), giving the Assyria/Egypt pair; KJV takes it as "fortress".
